subject: E-1100: token rejected on Android
body:
Hello support team. We run SyncVault 4.2.1 on Android 15 (Pixel 8). Whenever I log in since
yesterday, the app shows "E-1100: authentication token rejected".

We moved this seat from a shared account to a personal one. The title bar still shows the old shared
account after the move.

What I tried so far: searching the help centre. No luck.

Thanks, Hannah Cole (Meridian Schools)
